punchline: Epicurus lived on water and bread and asked a friend for cheese to feast.
thirty_sec: According to Diogenes Laertius, Epicurus taught in a garden in Athens, lived on water and plain bread, and wrote asking for a little Cytherean cheese so that he could hold a feast when he wished. He also refused to pool his friends' property.
question: Which small pleasure has become so routine you no longer enjoy it?
key_contrast: Few needs made a little cheese a feast.
